work: Chinese classical texts quoted by the passage map of board item RO: the 易传 and its commentaries, the 老子 with the 王弼, 河上公 and 苏辙 commentaries and the 郭店 and 帛书 witnesses, the 儒家 line from the 论语 to 戴震, the 说文解字 and the 左传 (止戈为武), 庄子 and 玄学, 墨辩 and 名家, 兵家, 法家, 管子 and 鬼谷子, the Buddhist texts received in China, 嵇康 and 王充.
edition: Two kinds of file. (1) Texts of two atlases built with Codex, each copied byte for byte from the atlas archive named in `atlases` (the archive member is given per file, with the atlas's own record of the text in `atlas_source`: its title, URL and edition note). The atlases' texts are electronic transcriptions: 71 of the 79 from Chinese Wikisource, five from CBETA (the 雜阿含經, 中論, 壇經, 成唯識論 and 華嚴五教章), two from xuges.com (王夫之《周易外傳》) and one checked against a scan of the National Diet Library (王夫之《思問錄》); the atlases do not claim them to be collated editions, and the excavated witnesses are the atlases' transcriptions. (2) Chinese Wikisource pages the atlases do not hold, at the revisions named per file. Neither kind is collated with a printed edition.
retrieval: Archive members: read on 19 October 2026 from the two archives in the external store, verified by their SHA-256 before reading. Wikisource pages: MediaWiki API, action=query, prop=revisions, rvprop=ids|timestamp|content, rvslots=main, format=json, formatversion=2, redirects=1, with a user agent naming the repository, on 19 October 2026 (fetch_wikisource.py in the RO kit, which never overwrites a file).

forms.archive-member: The archive member, byte for byte.
forms.api-response: The API's response body, byte for byte as received.

license: The texts are pre-modern and in the public domain. Wikisource's punctuation and markup are CC BY-SA 4.0. The five CBETA texts are CBETA's digital editions of the 大正藏, kept with attribution under CBETA's terms for non-commercial distribution; the xuges.com and National Diet Library notes are in `atlas_source`. The atlases themselves were built for this work.
markup: Wikisource wikitext carries character-variant markup, templates and links; a reading strips them (clean() in verify_ro.py) and keeps the content of {{yw|…}} and {{+|…}}.
reading_scope: Only the passages the map quotes were read closely, each in its chapter; retaining whole texts does not imply reading them whole.
